Hi thanks for starting this discussion.

I think the one most important action one can take as an individual to help the environment is - and by far - stopping to eat meat. (some links about why)

Then I'd say, focus on what is generally known as the 4 "R"s :

  • Refuse : Say no to all the free stuff that is offered to you (samples, gifts, etc.)
  • Reduce : Consume less, buy something only if you really need it, buy reusable things only. Buy organic and local.
  • Reuse : Reuse things, find another use for them, find somebody who can use it, etc.
  • Recycle : Recycle your trash and compost

And about energy use :

  • Drive less, walk, use a bike or public transportation when possible
  • Save water (quick shower instead of bath, no lawn, no pool, collect rainwater, etc.)
  • Use less electronics, unplug your stuff when you don't use it
  • Isolate your home properly

There's a lot more to cover, it's a big subject and we have to battle on all fronts to make a difference !

Yes you can compost in an apartment, I've been doing it for two years successfully with a wormfarm. I've had no odor issues at all, the finished product smells like fresh earth when you open the box but that's about it.
